messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and for detailing the cost indices behind it; we recognise the upward pressure on material and processing costs. Our starting point is each item's contribution to the price, distinguishing covered material from new exposure.

Even taken at face value, the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost, PPI-C2431 +12.3% at 38% of your cost - explain at most about +7.5% on the price, not the 11.01% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 88.0% (sc:70710@2026Q3).

The longer agreement supports continuity of business, and we are flexible on payment terms; Option B retains the payment term you requested. Please choose the payment and price combination that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.17 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.11 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.12 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our partnership and look forward to agreeing a price supported by a clear calculation.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We acknowledge your note regarding our delivery performance and have adjusted our calculation accordingly. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We are pleased to support a 24-month agreement with 30-day payment terms; however, for this duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage material volatility. Based on this structure, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.51 per unit.

Our updated Angebot stands at a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.51 per unit. This option features a price of €5.51 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

Thank you for reducing your price and confirming the material share in your calculation. We recognise your need to manage material volatility over a longer agreement, while distinguishing covered alloy costs from new exposure.

Your latest offer is still 0.2% above today's price of EUR 5.45.

We are making a modest price concession and are flexible on the index deadband, in exchange for a further price reduction from you. Option B gives you the alloy index protection you requested without a deadband; which index structure works best for you? We have taken your point on a fixed price: every option below includes an index clause.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.24 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.13 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.20 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 3% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your constructive engagement and would welcome agreement on a clear, defensible pricing mechanism.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We prefer the index structure without a deadband, as it provides the most accurate reflection of material cost developments. However, your proposed price for this structure remains below what is viable for us. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. 

We must therefore hold our offer of EUR 5.46 per unit for the 24-month agreement with 90-day payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause. For clarity, our offer stands at a price of €5.46 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Georg Aigner,

We recognise that an index without a deadband reflects material movements, and appreciate your offer of calculation transparency. However, you have left your price unchanged; this is disappointing, and it remains unacceptable without a reduction grounded in separating covered alloy costs from processing costs.

Our offers have moved 2.2% toward you since our first one; we now need a step from your side.

Both options provide the index structure without a deadband you requested and continuity for your planning. We are flexible on agreement length; which term works best for you? We keep our offer as it stands.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.13 per unit, 24-month agreement, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net.
Option B: EUR 5.13 per unit, 36-month agreement, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net.

Can we review the offered material and hourly-rate calculation to separate covered alloy costs from processing costs and identify room to reduce the base price?

We value our partnership and hope this calculation-led approach helps us agree.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
